traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2459999), until a flora read here gives it; drawn by the kingdom's leaf-shape rules where before the blade was shaped by eye.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2459999), until a flora read here gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2459999), until a flora read here gives it.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2459999), until a flora read here gives it.

generator.params.basal_area.note: The leaf area its `basal` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: its rosette leaves now take the species' cordate blade with its basal lobes, where before they drew the generic simple card (0.235).

generator.params.bud_area.note: The leaf area its `bud` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: the bud is now its flower closed, where before it drew the fruit ovoid.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), as Viola glabella: stems 7 cm to 30 cm tall. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small herb of leafy stems with heart-shaped, toothed leaves and bright yellow violets. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.2 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaves; yellow flowers.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.note: PNW Flowers on the species, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flowers 5-merous, solitary, axillary, zygomorphic; the Puget Prairie Plants wiki adds the lowest petal larger and spurred, the upper four in two pairs.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.note: Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5). Drawn as two lips by hand: two upper petals, two side ones and the larger lowest, spurred, which is how a violet's petals stand though floras do not call it two-lipped; its spur short, since the search results gave no length (the pages themselves were not read).
